control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - chemical exposure at PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on PSV-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically gas testing before and during hot work. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 December 2012 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
